measurement_provenance: All four serving Nitro gateways across eu-west-1 and eu-west-3 were independently verified through per-instance SSM connections against the Nitro root, exact PCR0, signed module identity, certificate/SPKI binding, TLS exporter and same-socket follow-up. Each passed a real inference smoke test. Both Auto Scaling refreshes completed successfully, and both healthy Fargate runtime pin consumers accept only this measurement. Running parent and relay image digests were checked on all four instances; parent Python and OS CA bundles exclude the compromised certificates. Source-to-image provenance is operator-asserted, not a reproduced-build claim.

tls.certificate_binding: user_data[0:32]=SHA-256 of the served certificate (DER), user_data[64:96]=TLS exporter channel binding

transparency.newest_check: The signature proves who wrote this record and when, not that it is the newest one. Search the transparency log for the identity above; the log is append-only, so a newer entry cannot be hidden from you. The bundle carries a Signed Entry Timestamp but no inclusion proof, so confirming log membership requires querying Rekor.
transparency.running_check: Neither the signature nor the log says this measurement is still what is RUNNING — an unchanged deployment should carry an old signature, so age is not drift. Fetch a live attestation from api_base_url and compare it against the accepted set in this record.
